input.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# turned union body with chamfered hex, through bore
length = 50.0
inlet_len = 21.0
inlet_d0 = 25.86
inlet_d1 = 27.13
hex_af = 27.0
hex_len = 9.0
z_hex = inlet_len
hex_corner_min = 14.228   # corner radius at hex ends (chamfer)
chamfer_slope = 0.75      # radial growth per mm from each hex end
outlet_d0 = 21.69
outlet_d1 = 20.43
z_outlet = z_hex + hex_len
outlet_len = length - z_outlet
bore_d = 14.0

inlet = (cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inlet_d0 / 2)
         .workplane(offset=inlet_len).circle(inlet_d1 / 2).loft().tag("inlet.side"))

hexp = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_hex)
        .polygon(6, hex_af / math.cos(math.radians(30))).extrude(hex_len).tag("hex.flat"))
r_mid = hex_corner_min + chamfer_slope * hex_len / 2
c1 = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_hex).circle(hex_corner_min)
      .workplane(offset=hex_len / 2).circle(r_mid).loft())
c2 = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_hex + hex_len / 2).circle(r_mid)
      .workplane(offset=hex_len / 2).circle(hex_corner_min).loft())
hexp = hexp.intersect(c1.union(c2)).tag("hex.chamfer")

outlet = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_outlet).circle(outlet_d0 / 2)
          .workplane(offset=outlet_len).circle(outlet_d1 / 2).loft().tag("outlet.side"))

body = inlet.union(hexp).union(outlet)
bore = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-1.0).circle(bore_d / 2)
        .extrude(length + 2).tag("bore.wall"))
result = body.cut(bore)
